question: Find the IDs of players who scored the highest number of partnership runs for each match. The output should include the IDs of two players, each with their individual scores and the total partnership score. For each pair, the player with the higher individual score should be listed as player 1, and the player with the lower score as player 2. In cases where both players have the same score, the player with the higher ID should be player 1, and the player with the lower ID should be player 2. There can be multiple rows for a single match.
sql:
WITH partnership AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.innings_no, 
           LEAST(b.striker, b.non_striker) as p1,
           GREATEST(b.striker, b.non_striker) as p2,
           CAST(SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) AS BIGINT) as partnership_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
    WHERE b.striker IS NOT NULL AND b.non_striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.innings_no, LEAST(b.striker, b.non_striker), GREATEST(b.striker, b.non_striker)
),
individual_scores AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.striker as player_id, CAST(SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) AS BIGINT) as individual_score
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE b.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.striker
),
max_partnership AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(partnership_runs) as max_runs
    FROM partnership
    GROUP BY match_id
),
combined AS (
    SELECT p.match_id, p.innings_no, p.p1, p.p2, p.partnership_runs,
           COALESCE(is1.individual_score, 0) as score_p1,
           COALESCE(is2.individual_score, 0) as score_p2
    FROM partnership p
    JOIN max_partnership mp ON p.match_id = mp.match_id AND p.partnership_runs = mp.max_runs
    LEFT JOIN individual_scores is1 ON p.match_id = is1.match_id AND p.innings_no = is1.innings_no AND p.p1 = is1.player_id
    LEFT JOIN individual_scores is2 ON p.match_id = is2.match_id AND p.innings_no = is2.innings_no AND p.p2 = is2.player_id
)
SELECT match_id,
       CASE WHEN score_p1 > score_p2 OR (score_p1 = score_p2 AND p1 > p2) THEN p1 ELSE p2 END as player1_id,
       CASE WHEN score_p1 > score_p2 OR (score_p1 = score_p2 AND p1 > p2) THEN p2 ELSE p1 END as player2_id,
       CASE WHEN score_p1 > score_p2 OR (score_p1 = score_p2 AND p1 > p2) THEN score_p1 ELSE score_p2 END as player1_score,
       CASE WHEN score_p1 > score_p2 OR (score_p1 = score_p2 AND p1 > p2) THEN score_p2 ELSE score_p1 END as player2_score,
       partnership_runs
FROM combined
ORDER BY match_id, player1_id, player2_id
